responsibility: Implements BPF ABI lowering for FnAbi by extending scalar integers to 32 bits and forcing aggregates or values wider than 64 bits to be passed and returned indirectly.
same_name_distinction: Unlike `asm/bpf.rs`, which exposes BPF inline-assembly registers, and `spec/base/bpf.rs`, which builds reusable target options, this file is only about function ABI lowering: extending scalars to 32 bits and forcing oversized or aggregate values indirect.
